completion_decisions: Implement PC-R coarse and fine, rectangle coarse and fine, and the 200000-sample Monte-Carlo reference on all four public 60-turbine layouts.
Use the paper's two independent uncertain variables and 3-25 m/s truncated Weibull rather than the precursor source's one-variable 0-30 m/s examples.

Use deterministic seed-indexed centered Latin hypercubes, custom numerical orthogonal polynomials, ten-fold degree selection and disclosed ridge-stabilized Cholesky because exact DAKOTA arrays are absent.
Independently translate the continuous three-zone FLORIS equations from Apache-2.0 PlantEnergy lineage and reproduce the author driver's constant-Cp/Ct 5-MW turbine abstraction.
Replace proprietary SNOPT with open NLopt SLSQP while preserving the 120-variable problem, 14-edge boundary, 2D spacing and 1000-evaluation budget.
Use fixed-width forward automatic differentiation and all-core wind-state parallelism with deterministic indexed writes and ordered reductions.
Run four Monte-Carlo references, 160 fixed-layout method/set roles and all 120 paper optimization roles; assess every final layout with the same independent 200000-sample reference stream.
Treat paper numerical tables as external anchors, not bitwise acceptance targets.
missing_information: exact two-variable Latin-hypercube and 200000-sample Monte-Carlo arrays
final two-variable DAKOTA files and selected polynomial orders
SNOPT version binary settings histories and complete stopping state
exact target FLORISSE revision and compiled environment
all final layouts trajectories and random states
nonzero spline-shift value if one was used

paper.authors: Andrés Santiago Padrón and Jared Thomas and Andrew P. J. Stanley and Juan J. Alonso and Andrew Ning
paper.title: Polynomial chaos to efficiently compute the annual energy production in wind farm layout optimization

paper_source_conflicts: The paper truncates wind speed to 3-25 m/s while the older public driver uses 0-30 m/s.
The paper reports function precision tolerance 1e-4 while the older public driver requests SNOPT major optimality tolerance 2e-6.
The older public repository implements one uncertain variable at a time and cannot be represented as the final two-variable program.
The author repository publishes no license, so it is used only as read-only semantic evidence and no code is copied.

scope.claim_boundary: source-backed flexible PC-R problem and protocol reproduction; not author DAKOTA SNOPT target FLORISSE random stream numerical table or timing replay

constraints_and_repair.resolution: 14-edge Amalia convex hull and at-least-2D pair spacing supplied as analytic SLSQP constraints

decision_variables.resolution: 120 continuous variables: 60 x coordinates followed by 60 y coordinates

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: four exact public layouts decoded to fixed x/y arrays and optimizer vectors

initialization.resolution: Amalia Grid and Random public starting layouts; ten deterministic sample-set seeds per method

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: AEP in GWh, selected polynomial order, physical wake simulations, feasibility, timings and 200000-sample final reference; ten sample sets

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize 8760 times expected farm power under direction and speed uncertainty

paper_native_cases.resolution: four fixed layouts; PC-R and rectangle coarse/fine; three optimization starts by four methods by ten sets

parameters.resolution: D126.4 m, 60 NREL-5MW abstractions, Weibull 1.8/12.55 truncated 3-25, 72 direction bins, 231/630/225/625 states, 1000 SLSQP evaluations

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: NLopt SLSQP maximum 1000 objective-gradient calls; every call records the method-specific physical wind-state count

training_and_inference_lifecycle.resolution: construct frozen LHS plan, fit and cross-validate polynomial order at the starting layout, reuse frozen mean weights throughout one optimization

update_order.resolution: sample physical states, build and select PCE, freeze mean-gradient weights, then execute constrained SLSQP calls and independent final Monte-Carlo assessment

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: continuous three-zone FLORIS with source-backed parameters, constant Cp/Ct, generator efficiency and 5 MW cap; zero unreported spline shift

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: cyclically linearly interpolated 72-point direction distribution represented by 50 equal-width bins for custom polynomials, independent truncated Weibull speed, deterministic centered two-dimensional LHS, midpoint rectangle products and traditional Monte Carlo
